decisions.decision: Review: Regulator VIN (U401:1) shorted to GND while VOUT (U401:4) tied to 5V VBUS and EN (U401:3) tied to VOUT. 3.3V rail receives 5V.
decisions.rationale: Connect J1 VBUS to U401:1 and U401:3. Connect U401:4 to the 3.3V rail. Connect U401:2 to GND.

decisions.decision: Review: USB-C CC1 and CC2 pins (J1 A5/B5) have no 5.1kΩ pull-down resistors. Power source cannot detect the device.
decisions.rationale: Add 5.1kΩ resistors from J1 CC1 and CC2 pins to GND.

decisions.decision: Review: OLED display specified in the design intent is missing from the design.
decisions.rationale: Add an I2C OLED display (e.g., SSD1306) to the 3.3V rail and I2C bus (GPIO14/15).
